display_name: DURA 条件残差扩散源训练
description: 以冻结 DURA、当前接收 IQ 与物理创新为条件，训练 clean−DURA 残差的噪声去除网络；固定八步、四条反向配对轨迹平均成单条 IQ。
authorization: User requests continued novel and DURA-combinable Phase1 restoration research, F-free/TX-label-free source training, automatic seven-view test and truth-last score.

code.environment: N607 GPU0 FP32 TF32 off deterministic; batch32 source GPU training; GPU DURA and candidate with frozen CPU classifier for ground prediction; CPU truth scorer

data.version: fixed source training cache epochs21/22/23; source diagnostic epoch19
data.representation: Paired source received/clean and frozen DURA output/physical variance
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 32768 source fit IDs randomly sampled without replacement after excluding RX4/6/8 day3 and the 672 fixed source pilot IDs

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Source-only 64-record real-DURA optimizer smoke and 112-source-record frozen-reader preflight; no target

permissions.claim_scope: F-free/TX-label-free paired source IQ training; F used only in separate source no-query preflight and frozen ground evaluation

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen DURA v1.0 plus independently initialized zero-output 1790786-parameter conditional residual denoiser
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original source-only DURA provenance and fixed matching source L_s/U_s cache; no F/TX/V/target in G training
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen source-only DURA and matching source IQ cache; fresh denoiser; frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL only in separate source no-query preflight and after G freeze
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch20, no target or source-score checkpoint selection

execution.gpu_policy: GPU0: one this-task GPU training/prediction worker; >=8192 MiB free and fewer than three total compute apps before every GPU stage; preserve other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop exact owner only on source contract or role mismatch, nonfinite computation, wrong checkpoint, target leakage, output collision, failed no-query smoke, or unrecoverable technical failure; preserve artifacts and other owners.

metric_names: source random-time normalized IQ and DURA guard loss

rows.method: Cosine variance-preserving residual noise, clean-residual prediction at random time; 8 fixed reverse steps and 4 antithetic latent trajectories
rows.purpose: Train only on authorized source paired IQ; no F/TX/V/target input
rows.seed_notes: Model 2026110817; source fit 2026110611; order 2026110813; diffusion time 2026110818; training Gaussian 2026110819; fixed antithetic inference latent 2026110820; evaluation 2026092701.
rows.budget_ref: 1790786 trainable + 266951 frozen DURA parameters; 32768 IDs x three source views x 20 epochs; batch32; random time and noise per training exposure

notes: Cosine-variance residual diffusion: random-time clean-residual prediction in source training; eight fixed reverse updates and four fixed antithetic latent paths averaged into one IQ.
Finite deterministic ensemble is not claimed to be a calibrated posterior or an identity-preservation guarantee.
Only legal source paired IQ and frozen DURA context are used in G training; TX labels, F weights or outputs, V and target are not read.
Fixed final epoch20; no-query real DURA and 112-source-record frozen reader checks precede training, then seven-view predictions precede independent truth-last.
Historical ground target is previously exposed; single-seed result is not an independent blind or real satellite result.
